I just downloaded the Redwood Benchmark Report that compared latency/cost for a few open models. The section on batching and quantization caught my eye — looks promising for a couple of inference workloads we have.

I'd love to see a short demo to understand how Redwood might fit into our stack and get a sense of expected throughput for our 8–12k qps bursty inference pattern.

Would you or someone on your team be able to do a 30-minute demo next week? Prefer mornings PST.
